product_launches.description: Superblocks launched Clark, an AI agent that enables technical and non-technical teams to build secure internal applications using natural language in a governed environment.

overview_description.description: Superblocks provides a platform for building internal enterprise applications, enabling development teams to create tools, workflows, and scheduled jobs using a combination of visual components and code. The platform includes a drag-and-drop UI editor, a component library, and integration with databases and APIs to streamline development processes. Superblocks allows users to automate business logic through scheduled tasks and workflow execution. The service supports secure access management, audit logging, and version control to align with enterprise security and compliance requirements. It also offers extensibility through custom code, giving teams flexibility in application behavior and design. Superblocks is designed to simplify the development and maintenance of internal tools used across business functions.

about_short_description.short_description: Superblocks is a software company that offers UI templates, AI interfaces, and generative app services.

product.name: Superblocks Platform
product.description: A governed application development platform for building, integrating, deploying, and monitoring production internal business applications using visual tools, AI, and code.

product.name: Clark AI
product.description: An AI coding agent that generates internal enterprise applications from natural-language prompts and produces extensible React code under configured data, design, security, and access policies.

product.name: Superblocks MCP
product.description: A governance and management interface that provides programmatic visibility and control over AI-built applications, integrations, permissions, queries, usage, and audit records.

product.name: Superblocks Agent
product.description: A customer-deployed runtime and integration component that connects Superblocks applications to private databases and APIs while keeping sensitive data inside the customer’s network.

product.name: Superblocks Embedded Applications
product.description: An SDK-based capability for embedding Superblocks applications into React, Angular, JavaScript, and other internal or external portals.
